blocks.html: Wahoo Fishing Cabo – Private Offshore Fishing Charters

Experience the Fastest Fish in the Ocean at Puerto Los Cabos

Experience the thrill of wahoo fishing in Cabo with Exotic Fish Cabo.

Known for their incredible speed and explosive strikes, wahoo are among the most exciting offshore game fish found in the waters of Los Cabos.

Our private sportfishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, offering access to fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, and La Fortuna when conditions allow.

Our experienced local captains adapt fishing locations and techniques to seasonal wahoo activity and changing ocean conditions.

Discover the excitement of targeting this powerful predator on a private Cabo fishing adventure.

Why Wahoo Fishing in Cabo is Unbeatable

Wahoo are among the most exciting offshore game fish found in the waters of Los Cabos. Here's what makes targeting them such a memorable experience:

  • Incredible Speed: Wahoo are powerful, fast-swimming predators known for explosive strikes and challenging runs.

  • Razor-Sharp Teeth: Their sharp teeth require specialized tackle and carefully selected leaders.

  • Exciting Fishing Techniques: High-speed trolling, diving lures, and natural bait can be effective depending on conditions.

  • Excellent Table Fish: Wahoo is prized for its firm, mild-flavored flesh and versatility in seafood dishes.

  • Trophy Potential: Large wahoo are possible in Los Cabos, although fish size and catch opportunities vary throughout the season.

Best Time for Wahoo Fishing in Los Cabos

Wahoo fishing opportunities exist throughout the year in Los Cabos, although their presence and activity depend on water temperature, ocean currents, and baitfish availability.

Late summer, fall, and early winter can provide favorable conditions for targeting wahoo around San José del Cabo. However, productive fishing periods vary from year to year, and wahoo may also be encountered outside these months.

These fast-moving predators are often associated with offshore banks, reef edges, current boundaries, and areas where smaller fish concentrate.

The size and number of wahoo cannot be reliably predicted by month alone. For a broader overview of seasonal fishing opportunities, explore our Cabo Fishing Calendar.

Target Species: Wahoo

The wahoo (Acanthocybium solandri), also known as ono, is a powerful pelagic predator found in tropical and subtropical waters.

Wahoo are recognizable by their elongated, streamlined bodies, brilliant blue vertical stripes, deeply forked tails, and exceptionally sharp teeth.

Known for their sudden strikes and powerful runs, these fast-swimming predators are among the most exciting fish targeted during offshore sportfishing trips in Los Cabos.

Fish size varies considerably, and encounters with exceptionally large specimens are uncommon and cannot be guaranteed.

Where We Find Wahoo

Our private wahoo fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, providing access to offshore fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez.

Depending on weather conditions, currents, and recent fishing activity, potential fishing areas may include:

  • Gordo Banks: Offshore underwater structure where wahoo and other pelagic predators may be encountered.

  • Iman Bank: An offshore fishing area where opportunities depend on baitfish activity and ocean conditions.

  • Punta Gorda: Coastal structure and nearby waters that may provide fishing opportunities when conditions are suitable.

  • Current Boundaries: Areas where changes in water movement and concentrations of baitfish may attract wahoo.

Fishing locations are selected according to daily conditions, and visiting a particular area or catching wahoo cannot be guaranteed.

Wahoo Fishing Techniques We Use

Wahoo fishing often requires techniques adapted to their speed, sharp teeth, and aggressive feeding behavior.

  • High-Speed Trolling: Artificial lures are presented at speeds selected according to lure design, sea conditions, and the crew's fishing strategy.

  • Diving Plugs and Trolling Lures: These imitate fleeing baitfish and can be effective when wahoo are actively feeding.

  • Wire Leaders: Often used to reduce the risk of bite-offs caused by the fish's sharp teeth.

  • Natural Bait: Bonito, mackerel, and other suitable baitfish may be presented when available and appropriate.

  • Adjustable Trolling Patterns: Lure positions and presentations are adapted to current fishing conditions.

Specific techniques and specialized equipment depend on the selected boat and available fishing gear.

What's Included in Your Wahoo Charter

  • Every private wahoo fishing charter with Exotic Fish Cabo includes:

    • Private fishing boat with an experienced local crew

    • Fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle

    • Bottled water and soft drinks

    • Fishing techniques adapted to seasonal conditions and target species

    Specialized tackle and additional equipment vary by boat.

    Fishing licenses, live bait, meals, transportation, fish-cleaning services, and any additional fees should be confirmed before booking.

Wahoo Fishing Tips for Success

    1. Choose the Right Trip Duration: Our private 6-hour charters offer opportunities to target wahoo when conditions are favorable. An 8-hour charter provides additional time to explore offshore fishing grounds.

    2. Plan Your Departure: Our fishing trips normally depart at 6:30 AM from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo. Always follow the time confirmed in your booking.

    3. Watch for Fishing Activity: Feeding birds, baitfish schools, and changes in ocean conditions can help identify potential fishing areas.

    4. Use Suitable Tackle: Wahoo have sharp teeth and powerful runs, making appropriate leaders, reels, and tackle particularly important.

    5. Stay Ready for Sudden Strikes: Wahoo can strike quickly and make powerful initial runs. Follow the crew's instructions when fighting a fish.

    6. Keep Realistic Expectations: Wahoo activity changes with the season and daily ocean conditions. No particular catch is guaranteed.

From Ocean to Table – Fresh Ono Dining

Wahoo is highly appreciated for its firm texture and delicious flavor. If you choose to keep your catch within Mexican sportfishing regulations, our team can explain available fish-cleaning and preparation options.

Some local restaurants in San José del Cabo may also offer preparation services for freshly caught fish. Please confirm availability, handling requirements, and any additional fees before your trip.

Why Choose Exotic Fish Cabo for Wahoo Fishing?

    • Convenient Departure: All trips depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

    • Private Charters Only: Your selected fishing boat is reserved exclusively for your group.

    • Local Fishing Knowledge: Experienced crews adapt fishing techniques and locations to current ocean conditions.

    • Flexible Fishing Trips: Choose between private 6-hour and 8-hour charter options.

    • Different Boat Options: Select a boat based on group size, fishing preferences, and desired amenities.

    • Clear Inclusions: Fishing equipment, bottled water, and soft drinks are included, with other services confirmed before booking.
